text: /// Ask the user about each undecided offer, then record the answers.
/// hook dispatch and anything an agent triggers use a quiet or capturing
/// output, so they return here immediately without touching stdin. In those
/// contexts the candidates surface as a `SessionStart` hint instead (see
/// Only explicit answers are recorded — the default ("ask me later") leaves
/// the dependency undecided, so reflexively hitting Enter never permanently
/// declines anything, and Escape leaves the remaining offers undecided too.
Some(_) => {}  // ask me later — record nothing
None => break, // Esc — leave the rest undecided

rationale:
`prompt_for_consent` (after the non-interactive early return) takes `discover_for(..).candidates` (offers `decide` classified as `Candidate`: not used, not auto-enabled, not disabled) and loops over them, keeping a `seen` set of names so a crate that yields more than one offer is asked about once; each remaining candidate gets exactly one `dialoguer::Select` question. Already decided dependencies never reach the loop because they are not candidates. Escape (`None`) breaks the loop, leaving the rest unasked and undecided, which is the user cancelling, consistent with `deferral_records_nothing`.

Untested: the interactive branch needs a TTY (`Output::is_interactive` requires terminals on both ends), so no automated test drives it; judged from code. `tests/enablement.rs` `consent_prompt_never_fires_non_interactively` only covers the inert path.
requirement: An interactive consent prompt MUST ask once about each dependency plugin awaiting consent.
